title: Replay Codex with complete Alignment Start parity

requirement.summary: Build and install the exact validated Adapter 1.2.3 development source, preflight the installed Alignment Start contract, and run one fresh uncoached Codex replay.

objective.rationale: Development Adapter 1.2.3 now validates the complete normalized Start boundary, but installed-runtime and fresh-host evidence are still required before claiming that automatic alignment proceeds beyond start.

goal: Build and hash the exact current source, update only the existing pipx AgentGov runtime, verify Adapter 1.2.3 discovery and representative retry/internal boundaries, then run one newly created Codex session with an ordinary uncoached multi-direction request and record only normalized outcomes.
non_goals: Do not present the local 0.3.0rc1-identified wheel as the immutable published v0.3.0rc1 artifact.
Do not coach the fresh Agent with AgentGov, MCP, alignment, self-review, protocol JSON, or tool names.
Do not retain or reconstruct raw replay prompts, tool payloads, transcripts, credentials, source content, host paths, or model-private reasoning.
Do not add another host, second Agent, NYC work, unrelated product changes, commit, push, publish, release, deploy, or mutate a consumer repository.
acceptance_signals: The exact current source is locally built with official Python 3.12, hash-recorded, and installed only into the existing isolated pipx AgentGov environment.
Installed discovery reports Adapter 1.2.3 and exactly five tools; the Start schema retains the documented parity constraints.

One installed foreground process demonstrates a representative retryable input rejection, a successful corrected transition, and the private non-retryable internal fallback without partial journey state.

A newly created Codex session receives one ordinary multi-direction request without named-tool coaching and either reaches the human direction-selection boundary or stops fail-closed with an honest normalized failed result.
No raw replay material, publication, release, deployment, NYC work, consumer mutation, second Agent, or other host is introduced.

items: The shared pipx runtime may be locked by existing AgentGov MCP child processes.
The local package identity remains 0.3.0rc1 and must not be confused with the immutable published artifact.
A non-fresh or coached session would invalidate product evidence, while raw output retention would violate the privacy boundary.

stop_conditions: Stop if installation would touch another project environment, need network access, or mutate a consumer.
Stop unless every locking process is read-only identified as an AgentGov governance-MCP child process before termination.
Stop if the replay cannot be run as a new uncoached Codex process or if normalized outcomes cannot be separated from raw material.
Stop on any required governance failure before implementation and record the journey honestly.

decision.rationale: The event-scoped replay reached the human-selection boundary and closed this requirement. On 2026-08-07 the product owner selected the separate deterministic post-selection contract slice.
